abstract: Morphological analysis of imprint cytology and histology was performed in 5 patients with yolk sac tumor (YST). The age of the patients ranged from 14 to 37. The level of AFP ranged from 460 ng/ml to 13,464 ng/ml. Five patients had a primary lesion in the ovary. These five cases of YST were histologically evaluated and classified into 4 patterns. As a result, the endodermal sinus pattern was the most frequently identified, followed by the polyvesicular vitelline pattern. As with imprint cytology findings in 4 YST cases, cuboidal cells were the most frequently observed; cuboidal cells and nuclei were both cuboidal in shape and 25-40 mu and 20-25 mu in diameter respectively. The chromatin had fine to coarse granular patterns. The nuclear.cytoplasmic (N/C) ratio was 50-70%, and each nucleus contained one to four nucleoli. Next to cuboidal cells, spindle-shaped cells were most frequently noticed; 20-40 mu in size with spindle-shaped nuclei 10-20 mu in diameter and had a fine to coarse granular chromatin pattern. The nuclei of the 30-50% N/C ratio cells contained one to two nucleoli. Naked cells and bizarred cells were also noticed.
abstract_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍（YST）5例について、捺印細胞診と組織学の形態学的解析を行った。患者の年齢は14歳から37歳であった。AFP値は460 ng/mlから13,464 ng/mlの範囲であった。5例の原発巣はいずれも卵巣であった。これら5例のYSTを組織学的に評価し、4つのパターンに分類した。その結果、内胚葉洞パターンが最も高頻度に認められ、次いで多小胞卵黄嚢パターンであった。捺印細胞診の4例でも、立方状細胞が最も高頻度に観察された。立方状細胞の核と細胞はいずれも立方状で、直径はそれぞれ25～40μmおよび20～25μmであった。クロマチンは細顆粒状から粗顆粒状のパターンを示した。核細胞質比は50～70%で、各核には1～4個の核小体が認められた。立方状細胞に次いで多く認められたのは紡錘形細胞であった。紡錘形細胞は20～40μmの大きさで、直径10～20μmの紡錘形核を有し、細顆粒状から粗顆粒状のクロマチンパターンを示した。核細胞質比30～50%の細胞の核には1～2個の核小体がみられた。裸細胞と奇怪な細胞もみられた。
